technical.summary: Strong trend structure with ADX confirmation and price above all key MAs, but extreme overbought conditions across multiple oscillators and lack of fresh entry signals create elevated pullback risk.

fundamental.summary: MCK shows no actionable smart money signals with zero insider activity, no institutional positioning data, no government contracts, no lobbying activity, and minimal retail interest; earnings in 30 days adds timing risk.

sentiment.summary: No actionable sentiment signal; composite congressional activity is neutral with only small-amount junior member sales, broad market sentiment is neutral, and news data unavailable.

risk.summary: Extreme VIX crisis regime (286.4) dominates risk assessment; normal yield curve provides limited offset; earnings in 30 days adds moderate event risk; macro_score of -1 confirms unfavourable conditions.
